rows.grounds: absolutive of pūjayati, worship precedes the giving
causative optative, third singular, command to give

items.question: After worshiping the great lady, what enjoyment vessel should be given?
items.inference: The rite commands worship followed by giving an enjoyment vessel to the goddess.
uncertainties: The exact ritual content of bhogapātra is unspecified.
items.plain_english: Having worshiped, O great lady, one should give the enjoyment vessel.
